answer: A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The tundra counter is kept in basalt and sonnet shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 14 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
